scope: All tracked binary files plus text SVG/LUT/animation data. ALS excluded entirely by owner instruction. Dependencies, build output, caches and gitignored files excluded. No assets removed.
method: git ls-files; safe files with a NUL in first 8000 bytes, plus .svg/.cube and arms-actions.json; byte length and SHA-256 of every included file. Credentials and protected paths never read.
